display_long_description:
A 12 player free-for-all PvP arena built to run at 240hz on Quest3 (or 207hz if you aren't able to developer mode your headset to push it to 240!)

NOTE: This is an EXPERIMENTAL game testing the capabilities of the Quest3 it is UNFINISHED and NOT COMPLETE. 

- 12 Weapon pickups around the arena
- Bots keep lobbies active
- Joystick locomotion(you can swap/disable in settings)
- Everything grabbable/climbable
- Some weapons have movement tech.
- Earn crowns for highest damage, eliminations, and health pickups.

CONTROLS:

Joysticks - Move/Jump/Crouch
A/X - Dash
B/Y - Drop Item
Trigger - Fire Weapon/Use Item
Grip - Grab/Climb
Joystick Click - Push-to-talk
Menu Button - Open Scoreboard/Menu
(You can also grab one hand with the other and pull to open the menu)

Built by the makers of DUST

join the DUST discord if you have suggestions/bug reports: discord.gg/dustvr
